Question
========
Researchers found that couples report about 10 arguments per month on average. If a couple received a z-score of -2 for this measure, which of the following best describes the amount of arguments for this couple compared with the average?

Answerlist
----------

* This couple had fewer arguments than about 2% of couples.

* This couple had fewer arguments than about 98% of couples.

* This couple had about 8 arguments per month.

* This couple had fewer arguments than about 5% of couples.
